_comment: Each mandatory clause of the project's own test rules, restated as
something a grep can find. This file is the machine-readable half of
.agents/rules/ci-rule.md §6 and code-rule.md §4 — when either rule is
edited, edit this too, or the audit starts checking a rule nobody has.
A clause with zero hits is a written promise the suite never kept.

clauses.requirement: Sanity must construct the real View + Presenter
Sanity must boot the real app via create_app()
Sanity must fail on any problem-level diagnostic emitted during boot/construct/shutdown, on every channel the app owns (Python logging, Qt message handler, warnings, stderr)
Sanity must assert the app shuts down within a budget, not just call stop() in teardown
Integration must drive real input and wait on a terminal signal/state
